values.quote: {{pp|key=%|12 to 24 for 7|1;3 to 18|formula=12%+2% every 3 levels starting from level 3 and capped at level 18}}

values.meaning: refresh interval for bonus AD from movement speed
values.binNote: The bin only lists HecarimPassive#BonusAD, a byLevel scaling formula; it has no separate data row for a refresh/tick interval, so this wiki-stated 0.25s refresh rate cannot be matched to any bin row.

mechanics.claim: Warpath's bonus attack damage adjusts to any temporary movement speed buffs and debuffs.
mechanics.quote: ''Warpath's'' '''bonus''' attack damage will adjust itself to any temporary movement speed {{tip|buffs}} and {{tip|debuffs}} '''Hecarim''' is affected by.

mechanics.claim: The bonus AD only applies to bonus movement speed, so Hecarim's AD never drops below base even if slowed below base move speed.
mechanics.quote: Since this only affects '''bonus''' values '''Hecarim''' will not dip below his regular attack damage if he is {{tip|slow|slowed}} below his '''base''' movement speed.
